name: Under the Microscope
summary: Metrics become specimens under a circular eyepiece: Acme Pulse zooms from 4× to 40×, and in darkfield only the anomaly fluoresces coral.
look: A black surround with a circular eyepiece, soft vignette and faint RGB fringe. Brightfield is near-white with teal-stained blurry cells; darkfield turns the field black where metric cells glow teal and one specimen fluoresces coral. Magnification readouts and a slide label frame every scene.

components.name: Eyepiece mask
components.role: circular vignette with RGB-offset fringe; instantly says 'looking closer'

components.name: Magnification readout
components.role: 4× → 10× → 40× → 1× in the corner; chapters without a progress bar

components.name: Specimen cells
components.role: rounded irregular blobs that each hold one metric in mono

components.name: Fluorescence channel
components.role: darkfield switch: healthy cells glow teal, the anomaly glows coral

components.name: Slide label
components.role: paper label for the hook question and the 'Specimen #2231' decision tag

components.name: Scale bar
components.role: white bar labelled '1 dashboard'; a playful unit that keeps it about software

motion.name: Focus pull
motion.how: filter blur 8 → 0 px, power2.out over 0.5 s (one beat at 120 BPM) with a scale breath 1.02 → 1

motion.name: Objective switch
motion.how: turret rotates, then a hard cut to the next magnification with a 3-frame white bloom on a downbeat

motion.name: Brownian drift
motion.how: specimens jitter a few px on seeded low-frequency noise; the anomaly pulses brighter on each snare

story: Hook: at 4× a field of blurry dashboard cells never comes into focus; a slide label asks 'How many dashboards did you check today?'. Reveal: on the drop the turret clicks to 10× and a focus pull lands the Acme mark and 'Acme Pulse' sharp. Proof: at 40× darkfield, Signups, Active users, p95 212 ms and Errors 0.4 % glow teal while 'Checkout conversion −18% since 09:42' fluoresces coral; a 'Specimen #2231 · after deploy #2231' tag offers Roll back / Acknowledge. CTA: back to 1× brightfield for 'Caught before customers noticed.', Start free and 'Resolved · 6 min'.
adapt: Put your own objects on the slide (tickets, builds, transactions, accounts) and use the magnification steps as your drill-down path from overview to the single item your product flags.

references.note: how fluorescence microscopy isolates one signal

fit.risk: Biology imagery can blur the product meaning; keep every specimen obviously numeric.
